standard.summary: 训练时重算 DiT block 以降低反传激活峰值。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Recomputes the DiT blocks during training to lower the backward pass's activation peak.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练时重算 DiT block 以降低反传激活峰值。高分辨率非 resident 驻留会由后端自动启用；手动开启可让预检和配置更直观。

advanced_en.principle: Recomputes DiT blocks during training to lower backward activation peaks. Enabled automatically by the backend for high-resolution non-resident residency; turning it on manually makes preflight and config more explicit.
